It applies only if tenants got the prescribed written exemption notice, in the lease for tenancies begun or renewed on or after 2024-01-01. The record left this out, so a natural-person-owner single_family/condo branch has been added, matching the sibling Cal. Civ. Code § 1946.2 encoding. The written-notice condition and the non-corporate LLC case cannot be encoded and belong in the exemptions text.", "exemptions text: 'certain owner-occupied single-family and duplex properties' omits the § 98.0703(l) individually-owned single-family/condo exemption and its written-notice condition. This cannot be changed through the fix fields but should be updated.", "key_value: the 15-day payment deadline and the age-62 senior definition are not in the excerpts and could not be verified.
